# herdsman project

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Keep projects, their folders and repositories, and work on their context repo.

```text
usage: herdsman project context init|check|note|log ...
       herdsman project log [--since <date>] [--task <task>] [--json]
       herdsman project create <name> [--description <text>] [--repo <spec>]... [--folder <path>] [--bind] [--json]
       herdsman project show [<project>] [--json]
       herdsman project list [--archived] [--json]
       herdsman project update [<project>] [--name <name>] [--description <text>]
                               [--add-repo <spec>]... [--remove-repo <name>]... [--json]
       herdsman project delete [<project>] [--force]
       herdsman project bind [<project>] [--folder <path>] [--json]
       herdsman project unbind [--folder <path>] [--json]

context and log work on the context repo of the project bound to this folder.

Keeps the projects, the folders bound to them and their repositories. A <spec>
is [<name>=]<path>[:<branch>[:<remote>]]; the name defaults to the folder's.
create binds --folder, or this folder with --bind.
<project> is a name, an id or @; left out, it is the project bound to this
folder. delete refuses a project with open tasks, tasks on a running route,
or task worktrees still present. --force archives it and keeps its records.

exit codes:
  0  done
  1  check found problems, the record was not found, the daemon refused, or it is not running
  2  bad usage
```

## herdsman project context

```text
usage: herdsman project context init
       herdsman project context check
       herdsman project context note --actor <who> [--task <task>] [--repo <repo>]... [--parent <id>]... <text>
       herdsman project context log [--since <date>] [--task <task>] [--json]

Run inside a folder bound to a project.

init lays out the context repo and prints its folder.
check validates the history and prints each problem.
note adds a note to the history and prints its id. Without --parent it joins
every open branch of the history.
log prints the history; it is the same command as herdsman project log.

exit codes:
  0  done; for check, the history is sound
  1  check found problems, the daemon refused, or it is not running
  2  bad usage
```

## herdsman project log

```text
usage: herdsman project log [--since <date>] [--task <task>] [--json]

Print the history of the project bound to this folder, parents before
children, then by time. --since takes YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

exit codes:
  0  printed
  1  the daemon refused, or it is not running
  2  bad usage
```
